basis: renders a native <header> wrapping the Menubar and WindowControls patterns — the landmark is the contract and the controls' roles are their own.

responsive.basis: one fixed-height drag-strip row of icons; nothing in it scales, wraps or reflows with the viewport.

interaction.basis: a bar hosting window controls it does not own.

exceptions.because: no harness spec yet — keyboard passage between the hosted controls is unproven in browser; the spec lands with the interaction-evidence tranche
